name: How does glass replacement differ for a room addition versus a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does glass replacement differ for a room addition versus a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a room addition, glass replacement primarily involves selecting new windows that integrate seamlessly with the existing home's architecture and energy performance while fulfilling the specific needs of the new space. In a whole-home remodel, the scope for glass replacement can be much broader, often involving a complete reassessment of all windows to achieve a unified aesthetic and consistent energy efficiency throughout the entire residence. The managed process of AKN Design Group ensures coordination regardless of project scale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Glass replacement in a room addition focuses on integrating new windows into the existing home, while a whole-home remodel allows for a comprehensive, unified aesthetic and energy upgrade.
